# SimSIMD 6.5.16

Pinned sources from tag `v6.5.16`. The GitHub repository was later renamed to NumKong, so a source archive of this tag unpacks as `NumKong-6.5.16`. The tree here is that tag: `VERSION` is `6.5.16`, and the symbols are `simsimd_*`.

Upstream license: Apache-2.0, in `LICENSE`.
Only `include/simsimd/` and `c/lib.c` are kept. `c/lib.c` is the runtime-dispatch entry points and is compiled into the extension.
